tei:div.tei:p: 607) ༄༅/ grub dbang pad+ma nor bu'i bka' 'bum ga rtags can la/ gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha snyan brgyud zab mo'i skor las bla ma drag po badz+ra ki la ya'i phrin las dngos grub char 'bebs ldeb/ gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha'i lhan thabs bla ma drag po ki la ya'i gtor ma'i las rim rgyala'agong gdug pa tshar gcod ldeb/ gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha'i lhan thabs gur drag phur 'jug can gyi gtor bzlog gdug pa tshar gcod ldeb/ phur mjug bskang ba ldeb/ bla ma drag po'i gter srung spu gri mched gsum gyi gtor 'bu la ldeb/ dpal chen bka' 'dus rgya mtsho'i cha lag 'jig rten mchod bstod bsgrub pa dregs pa dbang sdud ldeb/ dpal chen bka' 'dus rgya mtsho'i cha lag dmod pa drag sngags sgrub pa dgra bgegs snying 'byin ldeb/ dpal chen bka' 'dus rgya mtsho'i cha lag ma mo rbod gtong sgrub ba srid gsum zil gnon ldeb/ snga 'gyur bka' ma'i drag dmar 'o bran lugs kyi brgyud 'debs 608)dang brag dmar 'o bran lugs kyi sgrub thabs dngos grub char 'bebs bcas la ldeb/ gro lod brgyud 'debs ldeb/ dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi sgo nas 'phang ba zor gyi las rim gnam lcags thog mda' ldeb/ 'od gsal rdo rje gsang mdzod las/ rdo rje gro lod kyi bsnyen yig mdor bsdus ldeb/ 'od gsal snying gi thig le'i dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi smin byed ye shes mchog stsol ldeb/ dbang chen rdo rje gro lod la brten nas srid pa'i 'dre lnga'i glud mdos btang tshul ldeb/ dbang chen rdo rje grolod kyi mnan pa'i yig chung gcig shes kun grol ldeb/ btsa' gtor rdzas ldeb/ dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi sgo nas tshe 'das la phan btags pa'i 'dul gyi phrin las sbyar tshul ldeb/ dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi sgo nas mnan pa'i las rim ri rab nag po ldeb/ bzlog pa ldeb/

dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi sgo nas sreg pa hom gyi gzer ka bskal pa'i me chen ldeb/ 'od gsal snying gi thig le las/ rdo rje gro lod 609)sgrub thabs ldeb/ tshogs bdag rten bzhengs thabs ldeb/ mkhas grub karma chags med kyi lo yag cho ga snying por dril ba ldeb/ 'jigs byed me yi phreng ba las/ lhan thabs dpa' bo'i g.yul bshoms ldeb/ tshe ring mched lnga'i bskul pa ldeb/ phur zlog ldeb/ gnas bdag chen po'i gsol mchod 'dod don lhun grub ldeb/ rab gnas bkra shis char 'bebs phyag len rgyas par spros pa'i zur 'debs dge legs bdud rtsi'i sprin chen zhes bya ba ldeb/ tshe bdag stobs chen mchod rten sgrub pa'i ngag 'don khol phyung ldeb/ tshogs mchod ldeb/ bla ma'i gsol 'debs ldeb/ bka' srung gsol bsdus phrin las myur mgyogs ldeb/ bla brgyud kha bskang ldeb/ rat+na'i thugs chen gsang 'dus kyi dbang gi mtshams sbyor khyer bder bkod pa yid ches gsum ldan bya ba ldeb/ rat+na'i thugs sgrub rjes 'brel ldeb/ 'dul ba gri yi zin 610)bris 'don bder bkod pa ldeb/ thugs chen gsang 'dus brgyud 'debs ldeb/ thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa'i gsang sgrub rgyun gyi phrin las gzhan phan mkha' khyab ldeb/ gnam chos thugs gter gyi cha lag bka' srung a phyi chos kyi sgron ma'i mchod gsol sman btsun dgyes pa'i rol mo zhes bya ba ldeb/ gnam chos thugs gter lhan thabs bka' srung a phyi mched lnga'i bka' gtad dam can bla chags ldeb/ dkar chag ldeb/ bcas bsdoms ldeb/ ༈ rgyal kun spyi gzugs mtsho skyes rje'i// ring lugs 'dzin la zla bral ba// thub bstan chos kyi glang po yi// phrin las sa gsum khyab gyur cig/ dge'o//
